description: Aggregate questions about the corpus (how many papers disclose a Sharpe ratio / report a backtest / have code, the highest or lowest reported Sharpe, annual return or drawdown, averages, top-N, optionally in an asset class, since a year, net of costs) are answered exactly from the database with the papers linked (engine: sql). Otherwise a retrieval-augmented answer: the question is searched semantically over every paper page, guide and tool, and a language model answers ONLY from the retrieved pages, citing them as markdown links. Returns the answer text plus a sources array of {title, url, kind}. Scores quoted in the answer come from the page text; verify with get_paper. Metered (retrieval + generation): 5 calls per minute and a daily budget; when exhausted, use semantic_search / search_papers.
